findings.title: Volant Manticore: New Iranian Cyber Espionage Group Expands Cyber Espionage Across Europe and the Middle East
findings.summary_md: Check Point's blog post announced Volant Manticore as a previously undocumented Iran-nexus group that made Cyprus a primary espionage target before expanding to Saudi Arabia in September 2026. It describes the AI-generated Athena Marinou CV lure, KuboShell command and control over IPFS and Pinata, the Homa Framework, and the use of NetLock RMM, N-able RMM and MeshCentral. Check Point assesses with medium confidence that the group is a spin-off of former MuddyWater operators and reads the Saudi healthcare phishing spike as tied to geopolitical priorities.

findings.title: Volant Manticore: Flying Under the Radar
findings.summary_md: The full Check Point Research report traces Volant Manticore activity back to September 2025 and details how KuboShell uses Pinata-pinned IPFS files as a command mailbox, registering hosts with MAC-derived files in C:\Users\Public and polling every 60 seconds. It maps the three Homa Framework stages to 185.205.187[.]109 on port 8000 and connects an earlier January 2026 Word lure to 185.205.187[.]108:25498. The report documents the pivot to Saudi healthcare in September 2026 and publishes file hashes, domains, and details of operator testing environments.
